entry_conditions: continuous public passage can remain open
reversible fixing surface can be verified

fire, utility or heritage restriction prevents reversible installation
carriers.reversible_scope: freestanding shade, seating, signage and service kit only
carriers.restoration_acceptance: remove kit, restore surface and verify ordinary passage

entry_conditions: written site-access and shared-ground-floor agreement pending confirmation

entry_conditions: event, learning and ordinary passage uses can be separated
fire, structure, operations and neighbour impacts can be reviewed

no maintenance route or emergency review path
